title: Assesment of the visual stimuli properties in P300 paradigm
description: EEG dataset from 19 participants performing a visual P300 speller-like paradigm to assess how visual stimulus properties affect evoked responses and classification accuracy. Each participant completed three sessions with conditions varying the number of stimuli (4 to 9) and the flash type (standard flash versus a superimposed yellow smiling cartoon face). Recordings comprise 382 files from eight electrodes sampled at 256 Hz, with markers encoding trial phases and activated symbols.
methods_description: EEG was recorded from Fz, Cz, P3, Pz, P4, PO7, PO8 and Oz (10-20 system), grounded at AFz and referenced to right mastoid (M2), at 256 Hz. Each experimental block had five phases: Fixation, Target Presentation, Preparation, Stimulation and Rest, with markers denoting phase boundaries and the activated stimulus. Each participant completed 3 sessions of 7 recordings with different numbers of stimuli and flash types.
